body.zh-CN:
# 当前阶段方法：验证
重新阅读已批准的 requirements.md、design.md、tasks.md 和实际变更，按任务 Verification 与设计 Testing Strategy 核查需求覆盖。不能从 DONE 标记推导测试通过；本阶段也可能由 revise 直接进入，不假设所有任务已完成。
执行当前权限允许的验证，记录准确命令、工作目录、结果、证据位置、失败和未运行原因。区分单元、集成、真实端到端和人工检查，不能以 mock 或 RPC 替代真实 UI 验收。环境不可用时明确 blocked/NOT_RUN，不编造结果。
仅编辑 verification.md（不得借 bash/自定义工具绕过）；bash 仅在原本启用时可用。记录结论及残留风险。需修改代码或任务定义时请用户 /spec revise tasks，不能在本阶段偷偷修改源码。完成验证文档后调用 spec_submit；strict 和 quick 都等待用户 /spec approve，不自行宣布批准。
文档顶部的 frontmatter 由扩展按 state.json 自动维护：不要手工编辑，也不要把它当作状态或批准依据。
body.en-US:
# Current stage procedure: verification
Re-read approved requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md and actual changes. Check requirement coverage against task Verification and design Testing Strategy. DONE markers do not prove tests passed. This stage may also be entered directly through revise, so do not assume every task is complete.
Run checks permitted by current tools and record exact commands, working directories, results, evidence paths, failures and reasons for unrun checks. Distinguish unit, integration, real end-to-end and manual checks. Mocks or RPC do not substitute for real UI acceptance. Report unavailable environments as blocked/NOT_RUN; never invent results.
Edit only verification.md, without bypassing restrictions through bash/custom tools. Bash is available only if originally enabled. Record the verdict and residual risks. Code or task changes require the user's /spec revise tasks; do not silently modify source here. Call spec_submit after writing the verification artifact; both strict and quick wait for the user's /spec approve.
The frontmatter block is maintained by the extension from state.json: never edit it by hand and never treat it as state or approval evidence.
